The Midnight Dial

This is a work of fiction. Elias kept his smartphone in a locked drawer, yet every morning, the call log showed a three-minute conversation at 3:14 AM.

He never heard the chime, only the heavy, unearned exhaustion of a man who had been talking for hours. 'The connection is established,' he whispered.

On November 23, 2026, he finally wore noise-canceling headphones set to trigger a piercing siren at the slightest vibration of the nightstand.

When the phone buzzed against the wood, the alarm jolted him upright into the dark. He snatched the device, pressing it to his ear.

A dry, familiar voice on the other end spoke with his own slow cadence. 'The connection is established,' the voice said softly.

'Now please, for our sake, stop trying to wake up.' Elias looked at the screen; the incoming call was coming from his own number.
